WITH global_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(bandusagepct) AS global_avg_usage
  FROM telescopes
  WHERE bandusagepct IS NOT NULL
),
station_avgs AS (
  SELECT 
    observstation,
    AVG(bandusagepct) AS station_avg_usage
  FROM telescopes
  WHERE bandusagepct IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY observstation
),
above_average_stations AS (
  SELECT sa.station_avg_usage
  FROM station_avgs sa
  CROSS JOIN global_avg ga
  WHERE sa.station_avg_usage > ga.global_avg_usage
)
SELECT 
  AVG(station_avg_usage) AS mean_bandwidth_usage,
  AVG(station_avg_usage) - (SELECT global_avg_usage FROM global_avg) AS above_average
FROM above_average_stations;

assumptions.assumption: "Missing usage values" means NULL entries in bandusagepct; these are excluded from all average calculations using WHERE bandusagepct IS NOT NULL

"How far above average are they on average" means the difference between the mean bandwidth usage of above-average stations and the global average (i.e., mean of the filtered stations minus the global average)
